scope: Exact weakest canonical-orthogonal rank hypothesis, the strong-Coble K3-cover class theorem, and frozen carrier calibrations. This is not a universal polytope-to-surface theorem.

rank_theorem.minimal_hypothesis: A positive-similarity injection of the full restriction-of-scalars trace space T into Num(X)_Q with image contained in K_X^perp, for one minimal smooth projective surface X.

strong_coble_cover_theorem.cover: The double cover branched over the smooth disjoint divisor B in |-2K_S| is a smooth K3 surface.
strong_coble_cover_theorem.best_known_classwide_bound_source: Kondo, Coble surfaces with finite automorphism group, Section 3, citing Dolgachev--Kondo, Corollary 9.1.5

action_levels.M_coherent: a coherent faithful Coxeter representation in the global complex-K3 monodromy group
action_levels.M_generatorwise: each simple reflection has a global complex-K3 monodromy lift, but the chosen lifts are not certified to satisfy all Coxeter relations on the orthogonal complement
action_levels.C: an algebraic divisor correspondence induces the required pairing isometry
action_levels.I: only an abstract integral Neron-Severi isometry is certified
action_levels.none: no action lift is needed for rank because K is numerically trivial

claims_used: strong Coble means rational with a unique reduced disjoint anti-bicanonical boundary
the canonical double cover in characteristic not 2 is a K3 surface
every strong Coble surface has at most 10 boundary components
the finite-automorphism locus has exactly nine classes and maximal boundary count 8
the positive-characteristic Type-VI and Type-MII covering K3 surfaces are supersingular

huybrechts_k3_lectures.claim_used: Mon(X)=O^+(H^2(X,Z)), so every (-2)-reflection is a global complex-K3 monodromy element

surface_classification_input.claim_used: a minimal surface with numerically trivial canonical class is of Kodaira dimension zero, with the numerical-rank ceilings stated in the theorem
